name: Finalcad
positioning: Digital site follow-up designed to be adopted by people who do not want software — foremen and subcontractors.
description: Finalcad provides mobile applications for construction site monitoring: observations and snagging on plans, quality and safety checklists, progress tracking, task assignment and automatic reporting, with a deliberately minimal field interface.
real_estate_use: Field adoption is the whole battle: a tool a subcontractor's foreman will not open produces no data, whatever it can do. Finalcad's design choice is to strip the field experience down to capture and assignment, keeping the analysis for the office — which is why it appears on sites where previous attempts at digitalisation failed.
features: Observation and snagging capture on plans
Quality and safety checklists with photo evidence
Task assignment to companies with deadlines

use_cases.job: Get subcontractor foremen to actually record and close observations
Track progress and quality across several sites from one dashboard
